name: Brand, plus-ones & go-live

team.name: site-builder
team.owns: site/src/** code, components, RSVP/admin logic, tests, token usage

team.name: scribe
team.owns: sprint/issue JSON, .excn/CONTEXT.md terms, the Retro Loop

goal: Roll the invitation-derived brand across the site, make named plus-ones first-class Guests, add the registry link and themed QR, ship the admin roster, force HTTPS, and verify the rebranded gated site live on angelaandbrooks.com.

not_shipped.title: Apply invitation-derived theme palette
not_shipped.summary: Replace the nine theme color roles in theme.config.ts with a palette sampled from the invitation proof (cream/blush bg, fig-burgundy primary, forest+sage greens, dark text), contrast-verified, tokens-only.

not_shipped.title: Harmonize font sizes into a type-scale token system
not_shipped.summary: Introduce a font-size token scale and adopt it across components, removing the pre-existing Georgia, serif fallback; folds backlog issue 019eeb89.

not_shipped.title: Crop, optimize, and upload the home hero photo
not_shipped.summary: Crop the 28MB portrait original to 16:9, optimize to <=2000px / <=500KB for the committed public/hero.jpg, and preserve the original under docs/source_material/ so the asset stays under Cloudflare's 25MB limit.

not_shipped.title: Named plus-ones become first-class Guests (RSVP write-back)
not_shipped.summary: Per ADR 019eebb3-f8db: mint a guest_id for a named +1 at submit, stamp it on the rsvps row, and append the +1 to official-guest-list with a new source column, idempotent on (party_id + normalized name); is_plus_one becomes source==plus-one.

not_shipped.title: Add the wedding registry link to the Registry page
not_shipped.summary: Add a tokens-only registry link/button to the couple's myregistry URL (new tab, rel noopener noreferrer), replacing the placeholder; add an embed only if reversible and low-risk, else document as deferred.

not_shipped.title: Force HTTPS and add HSTS (fix the "not secure" warning)
not_shipped.summary: Add a middleware 308 redirect from http to https (via x-forwarded-proto) and a Strict-Transport-Security header so the live apex no longer shows not-secure.

not_shipped.title: Verify and document go-live on angelaandbrooks.com
not_shipped.summary: Per ADR 019eebb3-fedc: declare the custom-domain binding in wrangler.jsonc, deploy all Sprint 2 work, and verify https://angelaandbrooks.com serves the rebranded gated site (no not-secure, /admin reachable, valid TLS); document the rollback. Depends on every other Sprint 2 slice plus eb6f and 88b8.

not_shipped.title: Admin join roster: invited versus replied
not_shipped.summary: Admin roster joining the Guest List against RSVPs on guest_id, classifying invited versus replied; must account for ADR 019eebb3-f8db (the new source column and RSVP-added +1 rows). Depends on the +1 write-back slice.

not_shipped.title: Themed QR code pointing at the gated site root
not_shipped.summary: Palette-tinted QR (SVG + high-res PNG) with the A&B monogram encoding https://angelaandbrooks.com, scan-verified and handed off to the invitation designer. Depends on the palette slice.

step_log.summary: PASS — 0 violations. Chartered ADR, additive-only supersession, single-responsibility, no prescriptive language.
PASS — 0 violations. Chartered ADR, reversible, surfaces DNS precondition, no secrets in repo, single-responsibility.
